lines: Welcome to the Notice of Funding Availability (NOFA) webpage for the County of San Diego Health and Human Services Agency, Housing and Community Development Services (HCDS). This page serves as the central location for current and upcoming funding opportunities administered by HCDS, including programs that support construction, acquisition, and rehabilitation of affordable housing, community development, homelessness assistance, and public services.

Please Note: Funding opportunities posted on this webpage are intended for eligible organizations, agencies, and development partners, and are not direct assistance programs for housing support. Individual community members seeking housing resources or assistance, please visit our Housing Directory webpage.
For more information on Notice of Funding Availability, please email us at Community.Development@sdcounty.ca.gov.

You may subscribe to receive notifications regarding future funding opportunities. You will be directed to enter your email address or phone number to receive notifications. Once submitted, you will see a list of available distribution lists/topics. Select Notice of Funding Availability for Affordable Housing Development under the Housing Section, along with any other areas of interest.
At this time, there are no active Notices of Funding Availability (NOFAs). Please check back for future NOFAs
For questions about the Community Development Block Grant please email community.development@sdcounty.ca.gov.
